answer: Each identity earns one seat only after completing 24 randomly assigned useful jobs per epoch. A lantern beacon salts every job and publishes receipts to a vault; 7 auditors replay 5 samples, and 5 approvals activate the seat. For the kth identity sharing funding or device links, the quota is 24*k^2 jobs, so each new fake adds 24*(2*k-1) jobs. At the oasis checkpoint, reused receipts erase rewards and quarantine the cluster for 10 epochs.
